from collections import Counter
ti=G['Test input']
print(Counter(x for r in ti for x in r))
def boxes2(g):
    # rectangle outlines: color forming full top row segment and matching rows
    res={}
    from collections import defaultdict
    pos=defaultdict(list)
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        for j,c in enumerate(r):
            if c: pos[c].append((i,j))
    # for each color, find contiguous row runs forming solid horizontal lines
    out={}
    for c,cells in pos.items():
        rows=sorted(set(i for i,j in cells))
        # candidate box: rows where the row-run of c is widest
        # find bounding box of c cells that form a rectangle: rows with >=5 cells
        solid=[i for i in rows if sum(1 for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j]==c)>=5]
        if not solid: continue
        # top and bottom lines
        r0,r1=solid[0],solid[-1]
        cs=sorted(j for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[r0][j]==c)
        c0,c1=cs[0],cs[-1]
        out[c]=(r0,r1,c0,c1)
    return out
print(boxes2(ti))
for c,(r0,r1,c0,c1) in boxes2(ti).items():
    inner=[(a,b) for a in range(r0+1,r1) for b in range(c0+1,c1)]
